title: Simultaneous update
statement:
In gradient descent, what does "update all θ's simultaneously" mean?

[_]{a}

choices: Run the loop in parallel threads
Use the same value for every θ
Compute every component's update from the old θ, then replace them all at once
Use the new θ₀ when updating θ₁
explanations: It's about the math, not threads.
Each θ gets its own update.
Correct (the matrix form `theta - alpha*X@(h-y)/m` does exactly this).
That mixes old and new values.

hints: Which θ is used to compute h?
The old one, for all components.
solution: All components are updated from the same old θ.
